build_strongsort_yolox_config: build a StrongSORT YOLO-X config for multi-object tracking on MOT17 with CrowdHuman pretraining
configure_train_pipeline: configure a YOLO-X training pipeline with Mosaic, RandomAffine, and MixUp augmentations
setup_multi_dataset_dataloader: setup a multi-dataset dataloader concatenating MOT17 and CrowdHuman pedestrian datasets
configure_lr_scheduler: configure a quadratic warmup cosine annealing learning rate scheduler with constant final phase
